result.title: WorldForge V2: Eliciting Camera-Trajectory Alignment in Video Diffusion Models
result.summary: Video diffusion models have learned rich 3D/4D priors, making them promising for scene generation and video re-rendering. However, their use in spatial tasks is limited by imprecise camera control, spatial and temporal inconsistencies, and entangled camera motion with scene dynamics. Existing approaches, such as task-specific fine-tuning and post-process warping, often introduce visual artifacts, generalize poorly, or incur high computational costs. We propose WorldForge V2 to achieve accurate camera control while preserving the generative capabilities of pretrained video models. We first develop a training-free guidance framework using warped references to iteratively refine generation along a target camera path. Optical-flow analysis identifies motion-related latent channels for selective guidance, helping separate motion control from appearance. A dual-path strategy further compares guided and unguided predictions to correct artifacts from imperfect references. Together, these components guide viewpoint changes while preserving scene appearance and object motion. To reduce refinement costs, v-cache approximates the correction using the preceding denoising prediction, avoiding an additional model evaluation. We further extend motion localization from latent channels to network blocks and introduce Trajectory LoRA, which concentrates adaptation on blocks most responsive to trajectory guidance. A two-stage training strategy teaches these adapters to denoise the states encountered during guided generation, using limited supervision effectively. This enables reliable camera control with very little training data, with a single training scene already supporting generalization to unseen scenes. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations across multiple datasets show that our method achieves state-of-the-art generation quality and trajectory accuracy in camera-controlled video generation.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 WorldForge V2：用基于 warp 参考的免训练引导沿目标相机路径迭代修正视频扩散生成，借光流定位与运动相关的 latent 通道、以双路（引导/未引导）对比纠正伪影，并用 v-cache 与 Trajectory LoRA 降低修正成本、实现少数据相机控制。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按功能定位「运动」相关 latent 通道、以及复用上一步去噪预测的 v-cache，可能为 LVR 中分辨 latent 状态里的任务相关内容与缓存/位置效应、筛选视觉证据提供可供核查的线索，但属视频生成领域、与 VLM 推理链距离较远。
